extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) 3 rows with negative flipper_length_mm values (below minimum 170) were excluded; (2) 3 rows with body_mass_g values above 6500 grams (maximum allowed) were excluded; (3) two 'sex' label variants (' male' and 'male ') were normalized to 'male'. After these fixes, the average body mass for each species was calculated: Adelie: 3694.44 g, Chinstrap: 3801.79 g, Gentoo: 5173.33 g.
